extension.news: - Fix Futbol Libre servers stuck on 'could not resolve stream' (tarjetarojita.xyz and similar multi-hop wrappers): resolve() now follows ?get= redirects and nested iframes, tries the existing _econfig decoder plus plain playbackURL, and returns the real page origin for correct Referer/Origin headers - Fix playback still failing after resolve: some CDNs blackhole FFmpeg's TLS client (works via curl/browser, hangs 30s via Kodi's ffmpeg) - route inputstream.ffmpegdirect through open_mode=curl instead - inputstream.ffmpegdirect is now used only when present at runtime (System.HasAddon check), not as a hard addon.xml dependency - it doesn't exist for Kodi 18/Leia, so requiring it would have blocked the whole addon from installing there
